area_description:
From the report ‘Counting What Counts – A Compass of Progress for People and Planet’ by the United Nations High-Level Panel on ‘Beyond GDP’:
While well-being is not determined by income alone, sufficient material resources are a necessary condition for people to exercise choice and agency in their lives. Without adequate means, individuals and families are constrained to meeting day-to-day needs. Persistent material deprivation undermines people’s ability to plan, invest in their future, and participate in society fully. Beyond the monetary benefits of employment, work also provides a sense of dignity and self-realization.
info:
The "omposite rate of labour underutilization (LU4) shows the share of the extended labour force that is in unemployment, time-related underemployment, or the potential labour force. It therefore captures labour underutilization beyond unemployment, including persons who want to work additional hours and are available to do so, as well as persons outside the labour force who have an unmet need for employment. The rate is calculated as the share of the extended labour force:
LU4 = (unemployed + time-related underemployed + potential labour force) / (labour force + potential labour force) × 100.
